issue.title: Allow more uses of `beforeInteractive` strategy in Script component
issue.body:
This PR ensures Script component can be used in `beforeInteractive` strategy even if `src` is not specified.
- Fixes [#31275](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/31275)
